description: This PHP source file handles the calendar synchronization settings within a SuiteCRM module. It manages user permissions, triggers synchronization actions, saves configuration settings, retrieves synchronization status, and renders a settings template for the CalendarSync module.

classes.name: CalendarSync
classes.description: A class responsible for managing calendar synchronization configurations and operations within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: A class for rendering Smarty templates in the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the CalendarSync class.

methods.name: syncAllCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Triggers synchronization of all calendar accounts, optionally forcing a manual trigger.

methods.name: getConflictResolutionCases
methods.description: Retrieves possible conflict resolution options for calendar sync conflicts.

methods.name: getScheduler
methods.description: Retrieves the scheduler object responsible for scheduled sync jobs.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the current calendar sync configuration.
